title: Neumora Therapeutics (NMRA) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower After Analyst Target Cuts
summary: The reset in fair value for Neumora Therapeutics from US$6.53 to US$5.33 highlights how analysts are recalibrating price targets after revisiting their assumptions. Recent research points to updated views on the obesity franchise and overall execution risk, which helps explain why some targets have moved closer to levels like US$8 or US$3. title: ANI Pharmaceuticals (ANIP) Appoints Henry Gosebruch To Its Board
summary: ANI Pharmaceuticals (NasdaqGM: ANIP) appointed biotechnology executive Henry Gosebruch to its Board of Directors. Gosebruch previously held leadership roles at Lakefront Biotherapeutics, Neumora Therapeutics, and AbbVie. Board member Muthusamy (Samy) Shanmugam resigned from the Board and will continue in key operational roles at ANI Pharmaceuticals.
